name: Lacaille 9352
description: A nearby red dwarf, 47% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 887: radius in solar radii, 0.4712 +/- 0.0086, from the weighted mean of the interferometric measurements the table lists

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 887: mass 0.522 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 887: effective temperature in K, 3676 +/- 35, from the weighted mean of the interferometric measurements the table lists

text.card: A nearby red dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 47% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.4712 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 3,676 K.
